profile: Product engineer with **7 years** of shipping web products end to end, from discovery to production, most recently **LLM features** used by 2M people a month. Comfortable owning a feature across React, Node.js and AWS, and at turning a vague problem into a measured result.

bullets.text: Built the LLM layer for an AI listing writer serving **2M requests/month**: compared models on an automated eval set, then led the switch, cutting inference cost from **€500K to €90K/year**.
Led development of **Insights Hub**, an analytics product for business customers, and owned the phased migration of **2M+ users** without downtime.
Cut page load time by **40%** on the busiest pages by moving rendering to the server and trimming the client bundle.
Mentored **4 engineers** and introduced a design-review habit that shortened review cycles from days to hours.
Rebuilt the checkout in React and Node.js, raising conversion by **12%** over a quarter of A/B tests.
Moved the team from manual releases to **daily deploys** with GitHub Actions and Playwright end-to-end tests.
